cognates.Avatar: Turkish uses "Avatar"; Nextcloud core tr.json renders it that way too.
cognates.Deck: Nextcloud app name. Kept untranslated in all 16 finished locales.
cognates.DSAR: Acronym; kept untranslated in all 16 finished locales.
cognates.Id: Kept as "Id" in all 16 finished locales; following that.
cognates.Minimum: Turkish spelling of minimum is "minimum". Note the app renders Maximum as "Maksimum" — that one DOES change; this one has no such change.
cognates.RBAC: Access-control acronym, used untranslated in Turkish technical writing.
cognates.Slug: Kept in Turkish CMS/technical UI; kept in 8 of 10 sampled locales.
cognates.URL: Invariant in Turkish; "URL" is the standard form.
cognates.UUID:: Acronym plus colon. Turkish, unlike French, puts no space before a colon — fr carries "UUID :", which is why this key stays wrapped rather than being deleted.
cognates.Webhook: Kept as "Webhook" in Turkish; the app already renders the plural as "Webhook'lar".
cognates.{property} - {other}: Two placeholders and an ASCII hyphen, which Turkish keeps. Stays wrapped because ru localises the hyphen to an em dash.
cognates.3: Numeric literal; identical in every locale.
cognates.30: Numeric literal; identical in every locale.
cognates.N/A: Abbreviation shown as-is; not translated in this UI.
cognates.ConfigSet: Apache SOLR product term; SOLR does not localise it and the admin UI names the same object.
cognates.ConfigSet:: Apache SOLR product term with its label colon; see ConfigSet.
cognates.HNSW index: Algorithm name (hierarchical navigable small world); an invariant technical term.
cognates.OpenCorporates: Proper noun — a third-party service name.
cognates.OpenRegister: Proper noun — this application's own name.
cognates.OpenRegister Settings: Proper noun — the application's name; the app name is not translated.
